title: Blueberry Oath
logline: An oath is a key given in public, paid in fruit, with the egg as witness.
epigraph: An oath is a contract that remembers your face.
description: Chapter 7 of Lore.Land: Blueberry Oath. Boof swears at the market stone. The oath is a key that can be filed smaller, never grown in secret; the private price is blueberries; the egg witnesses. A shadow copies the motion and not the heat.

content.text: The market stone had a groove worn by other mouths. Boof stopped pretending the pursuit was one-sided. Something kept the same pace — a

children.text: that copied her steps and not the egg's heat. She set the egg beside the stone, scattered blueberries in the groove, and understood the public half of the oath: a key handed over in front of strangers. The private half was the fruit. The witness was the cell that kept its own law.

content.text: The shadow stretched across the cobbles, mirroring Boof's every move, but it would not warm. It was an unauthorized copy of a key — motion without permission, shape without receipt. If you forfeit a bond, the shadow is what remains: the gesture, emptied.
"Ah, you’ve found it, haven’t you, Boof?" the Fool's voice whispered from the long shade. "This is my shadow, or perhaps it is the oath's. Whose key is it if it can be copied without heat?"

img.alt: A cracked market stone, blueberries as the private price, a coal-dark egg, and a long shadow that copies the egg without its heat.

sections.figcaption: The oath-stone: public key, private fruit, one witness.

content.text: The shadow twisted and sometimes led. It seemed to know the path Boof sought and refused to show the heat. She did not touch it. A key that can be copied without a receipt is not a key you should grow. She left the blueberries in the groove — payment that smelled true — and carried the egg toward the well that keeps faces without stealing them.

content.text: "The shadow will always be with you, Boof," the Fool’s voice echoed. "But the real question is: whose key is it, and what do you forfeit if you lie?"

loreItems.description: An oath is a key given in public and paid in private. Fruit is the private price; the egg is the witness.
A shadow that copies motion without heat is an unauthorized copy of a key — gesture without receipt.
What you forfeit if you lie is the bond. The stone remembers faces. The fruit does not lie about being fruit.
